description: Ahmedabad Police to get high-tech Command and Control Centre with Artificial Intelligence Integration. This facility has been made as a part of the new Ahmedabad police headquarters that is going to be inaugurated by Union Home Minister Amit Shah in the presence of Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel on Thursday.
body_lead: Ahmedabad (Gujarat) [India], October 2 (ANI): To enhance citizen safety in Gujarat, the Ahmedabad Police has established a state-of-the-art Command and Control Centre utilizing cutting-edge technologies. This facility will bolster public safety and significantly improve police capabilities. A unique feature of the centre is that each officer will have three monitors, enabling them to monitor three locations simultaneously and enhance operational efficiency. One of the most interesting aspects is that the Ahmedabad Police will now also use Artificial Intelligence.
